page.layout: One column of text, with paragraph numbers in the right margin. The "Pag." label stands above the right margin column. A decorative rule runs across the top of the page and is not transcribed. Below the column are the signature "(a)" at the left and the catchword "emplaribus" at the right.

main_text.p: Præfationem sequentem, cum multis viris reverendis, summæque eruditionis maximè placuisse intellexerim, visum est huic iteratæ editioni, Synopsim brevem eorum quæ in ipsa tractantur præfigere, numerófque singulis paginis & paragraphis adjicere, ut lectoris usui magis esset accommodata, mendis etiam, quæ in editione priori (authore tunc temporis valetudinario) Typothetarum, exscribentis, aliorumve incuria, irrepserant, repurgatis.

p.i: Scopus & occasio tam Introductionis, quàm Præfationis. Paragr. 1.
Lingua omnium, initio una. De confusione linguarum. Ipsarum donum, usus. Par. 2.
Textus Scripturæ originales Hebr. & Græc. De versionibus antiquis, earum consensu, conservatione, collatione, usu, ad veram lectionem, & sensum genuinum indagandum & conservandum. Par. 3,4,5,6,7,8.
De celebrioribus editionibus Bibliorum huius sæculi, maximè Complutensi, Regia, Parisiana. De nostra jam sub prelo. Par. 9, 10.

page.notes: The "(a)" below the text is a gathering signature; the word "emplaribus" is the catchword, a continuation of "exemplaribus" with the initial "ex" missing as printed. The "S" of "Scopus" is a decorated initial. The "Pag." label and the margin numbers 3, 4, 6, 9 are printed in the right margin. Long s is normalised to s and u/v, i/j to the classical forms. The first lines of the synopsis are italic.
